title: Rome 1873 Propaganda Euchologion: complete strict Anaphora of St. John Chrysostom constituent — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Complete strict Anaphora of St. John Chrysostom in original polytonic Greek from the Deacon's opening call (Ὁ Διάκονος. Στῶμεν καλῶς...) at printed p. 61 (PDF p. 68) through the concluding doxology (Καὶ δὸς ἡμῖν...), final blessing (Καὶ ἔσται τὰ ἐλέη...) at printed p. 67 (PDF p. 74), and the immediately following choir response (Χορός· Καὶ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματός σου.) at the top of printed p. 68 (PDF p. 75), directly before the post-Anaphora litany rubric (Ὁ Διάκονος λαβὼν καιρὸν...). Uses the exact same 10 canonical native_path slugs as byzantine-1754-chrysostom-anaphora for 1-to-1 collation. Includes all printed prayers, ekphoneseis, expanded choir hymns/responses (including Ἅγιος, Σὲ ὑμνοῦμεν, and Ἄξιόν ἐστιν), full Third-Hour troparion, rubrics, and the Roman-communion footnote on p. 67.

pages.description: Cover, library slip, half-title (PDF p. 3), title (PDF p. 4), blank verso (PDF p. 5), preliminary instructions (Ἰστέον, PDF pp. 6–7), Diataxis, and pre-Anaphora Chrysostom Liturgy through printed p. 60.
Printed p. 61: only the Anaphora opening dialogue from Ὁ Διάκονος. Στῶμεν καλῶς... through Χορός· Ἄξιον καὶ δίκαιον... belongs to this constituent; earlier kiss of peace and Creed cue are excluded.
Printed p. 62: complete Preface/Thanksgiving, Sanctus ekphonesis and choir Sanctus hymn, asterisk rubric, and opening of Post-Sanctus.
Printed p. 63: Post-Sanctus continuation, complete Institution Narrative, and opening of Anamnesis.
Printed p. 64: completion of Anamnesis and Oblation with Σὲ ὑμνοῦμεν, and Epiclesis with full Third-Hour troparion through bread blessing.
Printed p. 65: completion of Epiclesis blessings and rubric, post-epiclesis/saints/Ἐξαιρέτως, and opening of choir hymn Ἄξιόν ἐστὶν.
Printed p. 66: completion of choir hymn (Τὴν τιμιωτέραν...), diptychs of the departed, and Church intercessions.
Printed p. 67: completion of Church intercessions, Ἐν πρώτοις with choir response and Roman-communion footnote, intercessions for the living, concluding doxology, and blessing.
Printed p. 68: only the top choir response (Χορός· Καὶ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματός σου.) belongs to this constituent; the post-Anaphora litany beginning Ὁ Διάκονος λαβὼν καιρὸν... is excluded.

Remainder of Chrysostom Liturgy, Basil and Presanctified Liturgies, all other Euchologion offices (ending printed p. 484 / PDF p. 491), and the separately paginated Apostle/Gospel appendix (PT1–PT108, ending PDF p. 596).
